# Model credits

Every model served from this directory, and the license it arrived under.

**Generated. Do not edit this file.** `python -m assets.pipeline build` writes
it from the source records in `assets/sources/*/source.toml`. Change a credit
there. The Godot client shows the same list, from `credits.json`, in the
Options pane.
